camel_example: aliyun polardb CreateDatabaseZonal --region cn-hangzhou --CharacterSetName utf8 --DBClusterId 'pc-00000000000000' --DBName testDB
description_en: Creates a database of an edge cluster for PolarDB on ENS
kebab_example: aliyun polardb create-database-zonal --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000 --db-name testDB --character-set-name utf8 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDatabaseZonal

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database. The name must meet the following requirements:

It must consist of lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_).

It must start with a letter and end with a letter or a digit. The name can be up to 64 characters long
parameters.help_zh:
数据库名称，名称需满足如下要求：

由小写字母、数字、中划线（-）、下划线（_）组成。
以字母开头，以字母或数字结尾，最长 64 个字符
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the database. The description must meet the following requirements:

It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

It must be 2 to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
数据库备注信息，备注信息需满足如下要求：

不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
长度为 2~256 个字符
parameters.name: db_description

parameters.help_en: The name of the account that is authorized to access the database
parameters.help_zh: 授权访问该数据库的账号名
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en:
The permissions of the account. Valid values:

ReadWrite: read and write permissions.

ReadOnly: read-only permissions.

DMLOnly: DML permissions only.

DDLOnly: DDL permissions only.

ReadIndex: read-only and index permissions.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is ReadWrite
parameters.help_zh:
账号权限，取值范围如下：

ReadWrite：读写。
ReadOnly：只读。
DMLOnly：只允许 DML。
DDLOnly：只允许 DDL。
ReadIndex：只读+索引。

若该参数不填，则默认为 ReadWrite
parameters.name: account_privilege

parameters.help_en: The locale setting. This specifies the collation for the new database
parameters.help_zh: 语言环境设置，用于指定新建数据库的排序规则
parameters.name: collate

parameters.help_en: The locale setting. This specifies the character classification for the database
parameters.help_zh: 语言环境设置，用于指定数据库的字符分类
parameters.name: ctype

parameters.help_en: A client token to ensure request idempotence. The client generates this token. The token must be unique across requests. It is case-sensitive and can be up to 64 ASCII characters long
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符
parameters.name: client_token
